args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was actually using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build's `tests/test_money.py` to fail (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py green).
